FIRMS_API_KEY.description: Required. NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY for live fire detections (server-side only).

OPENWEATHER_API_KEY.description: Required for hotspot weather and haze cones (server-side only).

NEWSDATA_API_KEY.description: Optional. Wildfire news on the landing page (server-side only).

VITE_CARTO_API_KEY.description: Optional. CARTO dark basemap; without it the maps use Esri's keyless dark canvas.

VITE_EVERY_ORG_API_KEY.description: Optional. Every.org nonprofit search in the Impact Hub.
